title: Scaling Unverifiable Rewards: A Case Study on Visual Insights
authors_zh: Shuyu Gan、James Mooney、Pan Hao、Renxiang Wang、Mingyi Hong、Qianwen Wang、Dongyeop Kang（机构：明尼苏达大学）
paper_type_zh: 多智能体阶段级测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 设计长程、多阶段智能体流程，且最终质量带有主观性、必须在最终输出出现前分配计算预算的读者。
one_line: Selective TTS uses stage-specific judges to prune weak branches early in a data-analysis agent pipeline, improving visual-insight quality under a fixed compute budget.
选择性测试时扩展使用阶段专属评审器，在数据分析智能体流程中及早剪去弱分支，以固定计算预算提升视觉洞见质量。
why: It shows that test-time scaling need not repeatedly refine one answer: a fixed budget can be distributed across process stages to reduce judge-error propagation.
inclusion_reason: It reallocates a fixed test-time budget across pipeline stages and prunes branches using local evaluators, directly studying how inference compute can scale multi-agent performance when the final reward is not programmatically verifiable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Many agent tasks are pipelines rather than a single answer: a system may profile data, make charts, extract insights, and write a report. Their final quality can be valuable but not mechanically verifiable. Repeatedly refining the final report with an LLM judge risks propagating an early mistaken judgment through every later revision, while spending the same branch budget at all stages lets weak intermediate artifacts consume downstream computation.

The paper asks how to scale an open-ended multi-agent workflow when a reliable terminal reward is unavailable. It needs to decide where in the process to spend a fixed inference budget and how to use imperfect judges without allowing them to steer the entire pipeline repeatedly. The desired policy should remove poor local candidates early, preserve promising alternatives, and improve the final outcome under matched compute rather than by simply adding more agent calls.

许多智能体任务是流程而非单一答案：系统可能先分析数据、制作图表、提取洞见，再撰写报告。其最终质量可能很有价值，却无法被机械验证。用语言模型评审器反复细化最终报告，可能把早期错误判断传播到每次后续修改；而在所有阶段投入相同分支预算，又会让较弱的中间产物消耗下游计算。

论文研究当缺少可靠终端奖励时，如何扩展开放式多智能体工作流。它需要决定在流程的何处花费固定推理预算，以及如何使用不完美评审器而不让其反复主导整个流水线。理想策略应及早移除局部较差候选、保留有前景的替代方案，并在匹配计算量下改善最终结果，而不是简单增加智能体调用次数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Selective TTS moves the unit of scaling from time to process stage. Instead of asking one agent to revise the same final answer over and over, it branches a data-analysis workflow and uses a dedicated local judge after each important stage. Weak profiles, chart choices, or insights are pruned before they become inputs to later agents, so later computation is concentrated on candidates that have survived the appropriate local quality test.

The paper deliberately treats a judge as a local allocation device rather than a globally trusted reward. A human-aligned harsh judge is selected for the visual-insight setting, but its influence is confined to the stage whose artifact it can inspect. This limits accumulated judge drift and makes the policy interpretable: the pruning ratio specifies how aggressively the fixed call budget moves from wide early exploration toward fewer, stronger downstream branches.

选择性测试时扩展将扩展单位从时间改为流程阶段。它不再要求一个智能体反复修改同一份最终答案，而是让数据分析工作流分支，并在每个重要阶段之后使用专门的局部评审器。较弱的数据概览、图表选择或洞见会在成为后续智能体输入前被剪去，使后续计算集中到通过相应局部质量检验的候选上。

论文刻意把评审器视为局部分配工具，而不是全局可信奖励。在视觉洞见场景中选择了与人类一致的严格评审器，但其影响只限制在它能够检查的工件阶段。这会限制评审漂移的累积，并让策略可解释：剪枝比例规定固定调用预算如何从早期宽泛探索逐步转向更少但更强的下游分支。

title: Method
方法
html:
The implemented pipeline has four contracts: data profiling turns raw tables into compact metadata and analysis directions; visualization proposes, executes, and repairs plotting code; insight generation writes chart-grounded interpretations; and verification scores the artifacts. Candidate branches are generated at these stages, then stage-specific LLM evaluators rank them. A configurable pruning ratio removes low-scoring branches before the next stage, while total LLM calls are held comparable to the baseline.

The authors first compare judges against human experts and select a harsh judge with Kendall’s tau of 0.55 for the main scaling experiments. They then test the full process-level policy on five public tabular datasets, alongside random pruning and a final-stage-only variant. Human evaluation assesses report quality, and robustness analysis varies pruning ratios, branching conditions, compute budgets, and an alternative dataset to distinguish early local selection from merely choosing the best final report.

实现的流程有四个工件契约：数据概览把原始表格转为紧凑元数据和分析方向；可视化提出、执行并修复绘图代码；洞见生成撰写以图表为依据的解释；验证则为工件评分。这些阶段生成候选分支，再由阶段专属语言模型评审器排序。一个可配置的剪枝比例会在下一阶段之前移除低分分支，同时使总语言模型调用量与基线保持可比。

作者先将不同评审器与人类专家比较，选出 Kendall tau 为 0.55 的严格评审器用于主要扩展实验。之后，他们在五个公开表格数据集上测试完整的流程级策略，并与随机剪枝和仅最终阶段剪枝变体比较。人工评估报告质量，稳健性分析则变化剪枝比例、分支条件、计算预算和替代数据集，以区分早期局部选择与仅在最后挑选最佳报告的效果。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the same stated compute budget, the selective policy raises the mean visual-insight score from 61.64 for the baseline to 65.86 and reduces variance by 39%. The paper reports that the selected local judge has Kendall’s tau 0.55 against human experts. The result matters because it measures quality in an end-to-end workflow where no exact terminal checker can decide whether an insight is useful.

The ablations support the allocation mechanism rather than arbitrary pruning. Random pruning lowers quality as its pruning ratio rises despite similar or greater computation, while pruning only at the final insight stage produces much smaller gains than full stage-wise selection. The human analysis also finds that high-scoring reports become more consistently strong, though agreement declines among already high-quality reports because their differences are subtle.

在论文说明的相同计算预算下，选择性策略将视觉洞见平均分从基线的 61.64 提升到 65.86，并将方差降低 39%。文中报告所选局部评审器与人类专家的 Kendall tau 为 0.55。该结果重要在于，它衡量的是端到端流程质量，而在这里没有精确终端检查器能够决定一个洞见是否真正有用。

消融实验支持的是分配机制，而不是任意剪枝。随机剪枝随着剪枝比例升高而降低质量，尽管计算量相近或更高；只在最终洞见阶段剪枝产生的增益也远小于完整阶段级选择。人工分析还发现高分报告变得更稳定地优秀，尽管在本已高质量的报告之间，人类一致性会下降，因为它们的差别非常细微。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive move is to treat test-time scaling as process refinement rather than temporal self-refinement. Earlier approaches often spend more computation by revising one output or sampling final answers. This work distributes the same budget across different pipeline stages and uses a different judge where the relevant evidence is available, so the system can prevent a poor chart or profile from becoming an expensive foundation for later reasoning.

It also addresses a boundary case for verifier-guided scaling: the final outcome is intentionally not programmatically verifiable. Rather than claiming the judge is perfect, the paper measures human alignment and constrains each judge to local pruning. That design connects reward uncertainty to a concrete compute policy and is useful for agent tasks whose final objectives are subjective, multi-part, or only partially observable.

独特变化是把测试时扩展视为流程细化，而非时间上的自我细化。已有方法常通过修改一个输出或采样最终答案来投入更多计算。这项工作把相同预算分配到不同流水线阶段，并在相关证据可见的位置使用不同评审器，因此系统可以阻止糟糕图表或数据概览成为后续推理的昂贵基础。

它还处理了验证器引导扩展的边界情况：最终结果刻意不可被程序验证。论文不宣称评审器完美，而是测量其与人类的一致性，并把每个评审器限制为局部剪枝。这一设计把奖励不确定性连接到具体的计算策略，适合最终目标具有主观性、多组成部分或只能部分观察的智能体任务。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The evidence is limited to five data-analysis datasets and a particular four-stage workflow, so its quality gains may not transfer to other open-ended agents. Judge alignment is imperfect and deteriorates among high-quality outputs, where fine distinctions matter most. The study uses moderate budgets and a small-scale eight-run ablation, and applying it in high-stakes settings still requires human oversight because a locally plausible insight can remain biased or misleading.
证据局限于五个数据分析数据集和一种四阶段工作流，因此其质量增益未必迁移到其他开放式智能体。评审器一致性并不完美，并且在高质量输出之间会下降，而这正是细微差别最重要的地方。研究使用中等预算和小规模的八次运行消融；由于局部看似合理的洞见仍可能有偏或误导，在高风险场景应用时依然需要人工监督。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a multi-agent task has meaningful intermediate artifacts but no reliable final checker. It suggests instrumenting each stage with a local evaluation contract, calibrating that evaluator against humans where possible, and comparing stage-wise pruning against final-only selection under a matched call budget. It is not a replacement for a true verifier; it is a way to spend scarce test-time compute more defensibly when only partial judgment is available.
当多智能体任务拥有有意义的中间工件、却没有可靠最终检查器时，可使用这项工作。它建议为每个阶段设置局部评估契约，尽可能将评估器与人类校准，并在匹配调用预算下比较阶段级剪枝和仅最终选择。它不是对真实验证器的替代，而是在只能获得部分判断时更有根据地花费稀缺测试时计算的方法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the random-pruning and final-stage-only ablations alongside the human-alignment table. The reusable point is not the exact judge prompt but the placement of selection before irreversible downstream work. For another agent system, define what each stage evaluator can actually observe, track how its errors propagate, and ensure that the apparent gain remains after holding total calls and model cost fixed.
应将随机剪枝和仅最终阶段剪枝消融与人类一致性表一同阅读。可复用的要点不是精确评审提示，而是在不可逆的下游工作之前放置选择。面对另一个智能体系统，应定义每个阶段评估器实际能观察到什么，跟踪其错误如何传播，并确保在固定总调用和模型成本后，表面增益仍然存在。
